conditions.reference_initialization: shape-specific retargeted qpos/qvel at same source clip/frame; no reset noise
conditions.actions: same absolute target_q bank across all shapes and initializations; PPO actions from existing kp30 source, replayed at matching kp30 (parity rerun of factorial_init_action, remind 8-45 follow-up)
conditions.primary_population: same group intersection surviving all 4 arms and 16 designs through full 1 second; conditional-on-survival, not fall prediction
conditions.fold: 4-fold held-out design, sorted design index mod4; seed 0/1/2 predictions averaged
conditions.factor_contrasts: difference in normalized morphology gain, rest minus reference averaged across action origins; PPO minus reference averaged across initializations; interaction also reported. Descriptive 16-shape comparison, no population causal generalization claim.
conditions.secondary_population: arm-specific all-16-shape surviving groups; explicitly secondary, never replaces common-population gate
conditions.resources: serial stages; GPU JAX40% / Torch30%, CPU2 threads, temp/cache on /home; watchdog stops own worker at RAM<4GiB, GPUfree<1GiB, rootfree<1GiB, homefree<8GiB twice
